implemented.originalKeys: Reserve 512 before original width/height/flags template and optional original empty pool array. implemented.canonicalEntries: On first successful original pool insertion, the same actual key holder owns its original key and actual original pool array: resident 256 + 2*actual key length + 8*maximum live array-slot count, plus 40 before original Map entry. Grow before push; existing keys/arrays remain the original owners on hits. Original pop/push order, per-key sixteen-surface limit and 128MiB pixel-byte policy remain. Slot capacity grows with maximum actual simultaneously held slots and is reused after pop; no per-frame retained key replacement or repeated slot growth.
implemented.cleanup: Retain actual canonical pool entries/keys/arrays across scratch boundaries. Delete Map reference before releasing the entry; clear original actual owned array and key references at scope-exit/device/allocator-first disposal. Failed key/lookup/growth frees attempted temporary metadata, preserves original null and previous key/list/native Surface owners, permits retry and never mutates borrowed native pixel content.
